plugins_intro: Enable or disable installed plugins. Disabled plugins stay installed but contribute nothing to the UI.
plugins_backend_intro: Write your own server-side plugins in Go. They run in-process via the yaegi interpreter, subscribe to lifecycle hooks, and hot-reload on save. Plugins may use the Go standard library; backend internals are out of reach.

cluster.title: Cluster storage sharing
cluster.intro: Securely share storage configs (incl. refreshed tokens) between nodes in real time. Nodes authenticate with a shared key; configs are end-to-end encrypted and converge via a CRDT. Disabled by default.
cluster.key_hint: Every node in the cluster must use the exact same key. It both authenticates membership and encrypts all traffic. Leave blank to keep the current key.
cluster.key_placeholder: leave blank to keep current key
cluster.peers_hint: One base URL per line, e.g. https://node2.example.com — reached at <peer>/api/cluster/sync.
cluster.share_drivers_hint: Comma-separated driver names. Leave empty to share every driver.
cluster.share_mounts_hint: Comma-separated mount paths. Leave empty for no mount restriction.
cluster.apply_remote_hint: When on, this node adopts storage configs pushed by peers (create/update). Off = share-only.
cluster.share_deletes_hint: When on, deleting a storage here tombstones it on every node. Off (safer): deletes stay local.
